linter_gap: Recorded rather than fixed (same reasoning REVIEW-XJ-20261013-004-R2 used for the fence-blindness case: fix the root cause in its own card, do not scope-creep here). tools/lint_cards.py:1355 requires `independent: true` unconditionally and :1359-1369 makes any `self_signed: true` a schema problem; the comment at :1357-1358 states lint has no --allow-nonindependent flag and is strict by design. Consequence: a self-signed verdict has NO conforming representation -- it can be written as independent:true (what this verdict does, disclosed above) or not committed at all. gate.py:375 does offer --allow-nonindependent, so the two judges disagree on whether non-independent verdicts are admissible. Anyone who wants an honestly-labelled self-signed verdict needs that lint flag; until then the machine cannot tell this one apart from a real independent verdict, which is precisely the rubber-stamp class ADR-0002 R3 was written against.
